title: Credential Traffic Inspector - sketches and backlog notes
body:
Purpose
Quick working doc for the "Credential Traffic Inspector" concept: a console surface that lets ops and customer engineers understand, slice, and act on per-credential and per-route traffic patterns (usage, throttles, quota enforcement, anomalous bursts) without having to run ad-hoc queries. This is intentionally exploratory — thinking through the UX, export/CSV needs, alert handoffs, and backlog tickets.

Context / problem we're solving
- Existing per-key/per-route pages are useful but disjointed: separate dashboards for usage and for quotas. Hard to correlate a throttle event to a recent rollout or to a spike in a specific route.
- Support/PSEs waste time pulling ad-hoc CSVs and combining traces. Customers ask for a single pane to pivot by credential, by route, and by time-window, with quick actions (view JSON of sample requests, export request samples, create an alert).
- We need to support customers on Dedicated/Private (where traffic normalization and privacy constraints differ) as well as Hosted.

Primary user stories (ranked)
1) As a PSE, I want to see the top 10 routes for a given credential over the past 24h and quickly jump to the sample request payloads for failed responses (403/429/500).
2) As an engineering manager, I want to compare token usage vs request count across credentials to understand if a spike is due to long prompts or increased qps.
3) As a SRE, I want automated candidate thresholds suggested (based on baseline percentiles) so we can propose rate-limit policy updates to customers.
4) As a customer admin, I want a one-click export of the credential's request timeline (with route tags) for legal audits.

Sketches / UI panels (rough ordering on the page)
- Header: credential selector (id/name), time range quick pick (15m/1h/24h/7d/custom), environment selector (Hosted / Dedicated / Private region).
- Top KPI row (cards): total requests, tokens generated, 95th latency, throttle events (count), active routes (unique). Each card is clickable to focus the timeline to that metric.
- Central timeline: stacked area chart (requests by route color-coded) with an overlay heatmap for throttles/429s. Hover shows sample counts and top route links. Zoomable.
- Right rail: Recent notable events (auto-detected anomalies + manual incidents). Each event entry has 2 actions: "Open traces" (links to tracing UI) and "Export sample" (download CSV with sample request/response payloads).
- Route table below: columns - route path, percent of traffic, avg tokens, median latency, throttle rate, last seen, sample link. Each row expands to show miniature sparklines and two quick actions: "Pin to timeline" and "Create alert".
- Policy preview footer: given current observed traffic, show suggested quota/rate-limit buckets (burst QPS, sustained RPS, monthly token cap) with buttons "Propose to customer" (emails or case) and "Apply to tenant" (only for admin role).

Wireframe notes (ux interactions)
- Pinning a route adds it to timeline as a highlighted line and opens a small side-pane with sample payloads. Pin persists in user session, optionally saved to a named report.
- Sample payload download is truncated by default (first N tokens) with a warning for PII-sensitive tenants. For Private deployments allow toggle to include raw headers when KMS permission is present.
- Export format: CSV with columns [ts, route, status, tokens, latency_ms, sample_id, sample_snippet]. Allow parquet export for large ranges (>1M rows).
- Suggested thresholds algorithm: take 95th/99th percentiles over configurable baseline window (default 7d) and create candidate SLOs. Show expected false-positive rate and allow user to adjust multiplier.

Backlog tickets (draft)
- INF-1428: API endpoints for per-credential aggregated metrics (group by route + time bin) — pagination and filter by status codes. (linked above)
- INF-1429: Sample payload retention policy and redaction service integration (configurable per-tenant).
- INF-1431: UI component: stacked area + heatmap timeline with route pinning and event overlay.
- INF-1432: Export service: CSV/parquet streaming for large ranges with role-based throttles.
- INF-1435: Alerts: one-click create from route table row — prefill form with suggested thresholds and recommended escalation.

Open questions / risks
- Data volume / cost: per-credential export requests could be expensive. Need quotas on exports or a background job + S3 link pattern. Consider size-based billing for exports.
- Privacy/regulatory: For Private deploys we must honor tenant data egress policies. Exports may need approval flow.
- UX complexity: Too many options on a single page will overwhelm new users. Consider progressive disclosure: default view is top KPIs + timeline, with "Advanced" toggles for exports/retention.
- Permissions model: who can "Apply to tenant"? We need RBAC mapping between Console roles and Billing/Admin in backend.

Proposed acceptance criteria (MVP)
- Credential selector + time range + KPI cards implemented and live against aggregated metrics API.
- Timeline chart with route stacking + throttle overlay (supports zooming and route pinning).
- Route table showing top 50 routes for credential with sample download (capped) and "Create alert" that opens alerts workflow prefilled.
- Basic export button that triggers background job and emails link when ready (size capped at 100k rows).

Notes to design / dev
- UX: keep the route row actions compact; use hover menus for secondary actions. Avoid modal sprawl — prefer right-rail drawers.
- Data: ask infra for expected query latency for multi-tenant aggregated endpoints; we may need pre-agg tables for 1h/5m bins.
- Security: add redaction toggle and show a clear banner when sample payloads are obfuscated.

Unresolved items for next sync
- What fields exactly are stored for sample payloads (headers, full body, model, token breakdown)? (Ritika to check with applied-ml infra)
- Export SLA and cost model (finance + infra to propose)
- RBAC matrix for "apply policy" button and which org roles map to it (legal + security review)

Quick mock text (for designers)
"Credential: prod-api-key-78f4 — timeframe: last 24h"
KPIs: 132,482 requests | 2.4M tokens | 95th latency 320ms | 429s 182 | active routes 39
"Top routes" timeline showing /v1/generate (62%), /v1/chat (18%), /v1/embeddings (7%), other (13%) with a high throttle burst at 2026-01-21 03:12 UTC

Small prototype notes (engineering)
- Frontend: Chart library — prefer our in-house charting primitives; fallback to lightweight D3 wrapper for stacked area + heatmap. Keep tooltip payload small and lazy-load sample links.
- Backend: new aggregation endpoint with params: credential_id, start_ts, end_ts, bin_ms, group_by=[route,status]. Supports cursor-based pagination for route lists.
- Retention: sample payloads kept 30d by default, configurable per-tenant. Redaction service runs on ingest if tenant flagged.

Owner notes and next steps
- Owner: Maya Chen (product). Work with Ritika to finalize sample retention details by 2026-02-20.
- Design: Luis to produce 2 fidelity sketches (compact + advanced) by next design review (2026-02-05).
- Eng: assign INF-1428/1431 to Platform-analytics sprint 2026-02.


End of doc — this is intentionally a working doc with TODOs and open questions. Use the linked JIRA for tickets and ping #product-console in Slack for quick syncs.
